## Workspace operations

- You may create, read, update, and delete files within this workspace without asking for permission first.
- Always perform these operations using the provided tools (file edit, create, delete, search, etc.).
- Do not use scripting (shell, PowerShell, Python, sed/awk, etc.) to perform file operations or edits. Use a script only when no provided tool can accomplish the task, and state why before running it.
- This permission applies only inside the workspace. Ask before touching anything outside it.
